question: What claim about these agents is at stake in calling independent family-impellers the four-age ones, thus addressed to the lord of gods?
premises: They are referred to as the four-age ones.
The address is to the lord of gods.
inference: Independent family-impellers are designated as the four-age ones in this transmission.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between caturyuga and kulacodakāḥ is ambiguous here.
plain_english: The four-age ones, thus, O lord of gods, are independent family-impellers.
